svg.title: Persian Cheetah · Storyboard · Page 1 · Sections 1-4 · Key beats
svg.text: Storyboard · Page 1 of 2 · Sections 1–4 (Hook · Difference · Where · What Went Wrong) · 16:9 · 9:30 documentary essay

g.text: Scene 03 · 0:18–0:30 · 12 sec · NO CAT IN FRAME
MOVE drone fwd, slow, parallel to ground
SOUND wind only · low sustained string
LIGHT hard white midday, raking L
PALETTE sand · pale ochre · cinnamon coat accent
Scene 08 · 1:00–1:18 · 18 sec · "We will not use it again."
MOVE STATIC · cut to right-panel-only at 1:14
LIGHT L=warm gold soft · R=cool hard white
MUST-NOT any African flora in R panel
MOVE drone fwd glide ~2 m/s, parallel
LIGHT low golden sun camera-L, long shadows R
TEXTURE gravel, Artemisia receding to ridge
SOUND piano motif (single notes) enters · wind
DIALOGUE V.O. "She lives in four places. Touran."
MUST-NOT acacia, baobab, jungle, green grass
MOVE Ken Burns slow push on cheetah figure
PALETTE lapis blue · gold leaf · vermilion
DIALOGUE V.O. "kings rode beside her... Yuz."
MUST-HAVE trained yuz visible behind/with rider
4.6 · Yuz carcass at roadside · the wound
Scene 22 · 4:36–4:42 · 6 sec held · score drops out
ANGLE body in left third, road to horizon
PALETTE asphalt black · sand · yellow line
RESTRAINT wide only · no blood close-up

svg.text: Master rule: every section opens on landscape, closes on a face. · Camera-trap is sacred (used as-shot). · 200mm+ used exactly twice (Sec 4 highway, Sec 7 final).
Light arrows: orange = motivated sun · Move arrows: green = dolly · blue = drone · purple = Ken Burns · red = static
